forge.label: Forge
forge.arguments.hint: Each field is one argument, not a shell command. The first is a program on PATH, without /, \ or placeholders. All four templates are required. Empty arguments and whitespace are kept exactly.
forge.places: Use {branch}, {base} and {commit} anywhere; {request} only in checks and merge; {title} and {summary} only in open, after literal text, such as --title={title}. Substitution happens once, without a shell.
forge.arguments.shown: Each box is one argument, passed as is, without a shell.
forge.warning: These commands run on this computer as you, outside any sandbox, whenever an AI of yours works on a task of this group. Join only groups whose commands you would run yourself.
